title: Schedule of Fees for the Operating Lines of Credit
content:
The fees below apply to the Operating Lines of Credit of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit, product by product.

## Fee definitions

- **Origination fee**: charged when a line is booked, as a percentage of the commitment, subject to a minimum origination fee in USD.
- **Renewal fee**: a flat fee in USD charged when a renewal takes effect.
- **Early-renewal waiver period**: the renewal fee is waived when the renewal request was registered at least this many calendar days before the maturity date; 0 means there is no early-renewal waiver.
- **UCC filing fee**: the UCC financing statement filing fee passed through when a line is booked, in USD.
- **Wire fee**: the fee for advance proceeds delivered by outgoing wire, in USD per wire.
- **Returned payment fee**: the fee for a payment returned unpaid by the member's bank, in USD per returned payment.
- **Unused commitment fee**: an annual fee on the average unused commitment, in percent a year, billed in arrears.

## Schedule

| Product | Origination fee (% of commitment) | Minimum origination fee (USD) | Renewal fee (USD) | Early-renewal waiver (calendar days before maturity) | UCC filing fee (USD) | Wire fee (USD per wire) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Unused commitment fee (% a year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 (none) | 20 | 20 | 30 | 0 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 0.25 | 150 | 150 | 60 | 20 | 20 | 30 | 0 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 0.25 | 250 | 0 | 0 (none) | 20 | 20 | 30 | 0 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 0.25 | 350 | 350 | 60 | 20 | 20 | 30 | 0.10 (0.1) |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 0.20 (0.2) | 1500 | 750 | 90 | 20 | 15 | 30 | 0.20 (0.2) |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0.15 | 2500 | 1250 | 90 | 20 | 0 | 30 | 0.25 |

## Points of reading

- The StartRight Operating Line carries neither an origination fee nor a renewal fee; its UCC filing fee, wire fee and returned payment fee still apply.
- The Agribusiness Revolving Line charges nothing for a wire.
- Only the Revolving Operating Line, the Borrowing Base Operating Line and the Agribusiness Revolving Line carry an unused commitment fee.
